Today we're officially launching the Advent of Agents calendar. Every single day we unlock a new piece of the puzzle to help you build production-ready agents on Google Cloud. And we're not just talking theory here: the goal is for you to get hands-on with code samples. We'll look at Gemini 3 to learn about context engineering, the computer use feature and the Live API, as well as Google's Agent Development Kit, where you'll learn about multi-agent workloads — loop, sequential and parallel agents. And lastly, the Agent Starter Pack, where you'll build end-to-end production agents including CI/CD, testing and deployment to Google Cloud's Agent Runtime, Agent Engine. So whether you're a startup founder or an enterprise developer, think of this as your daily crash course. If you don't want to miss out, head over to the link on the screen below. Enjoy, and have fun.
